title: Models (M8)
brief: Models screen of goop (/models), local llama.cpp servers only: hardware line with RAM, VRAM (RX 7700S, Vulkan) and CPU meters; one row per role (Chat · Orchestrator, Profile & matching, Security, Reranker, Embeddings) with model, quantization and size on disk, device, state, reasoning level and output speed; a failing model (qwen not responding, restarting 2/3) selected and unfolded with its last log lines, what goop did and context-sensitive keys (r restart, d device, ctrl+r reasoning, b benchmark, enter details, esc back, ? all actions). Status line with the models focus mode. Below the screen: the update download, a benchmark result and the status line alert chip that leads here. Model startup never blocks the TUI.

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: One row per role with hardware meters on top and the failing model unfolded in place (logs, what goop did, row-aware keys); hides the chat and unfolds one row at a time
